en: The dyad of "dissociated from the taints but with taints" and the triad of "with visibility."

Dependent on a state that is dissociated from the taints (*āsava*), is neither-tainted (*na-āsava*), is non-visible (*na-sanidassana*), and is impinging (*sappaṭigha*), there arises a state that is dissociated from the taints, is tainted, is visible, and is impinging, by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*) … one.

Dependent on a state that is dissociated from the taints, is not-tainted, is non-visible, and is impinging, there arises a state that is dissociated from the taints, is tainted, is visible, and is impinging, by way of root-condition … one. (By calculation, three.)
